Visit our YouTube channel to watch the full series and come and discover your potential. The Senior Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical and operational leadership role within the Tooling & Automation team. The postholder will lead and support infrastructure engineers while developing, maintaining and assuring a business-critical tooling stack used by teams across HMRC to deliver infrastructure as code and deploy services. The tooling is hosted primarily on AWS and uses EC2, containerisation and CI/CD technologies. The role combines live-service leadership, technical engineering, stakeholder management and continuous improvement, ensuring tooling services remain secure, supportable and aligned with HMRC architectural and operational standards. Job Description Live service and operational continuity Lead BAU support for tooling services, ensuring incidents and changes are handled effectively within agreed service levels and HMRC standards. Protect live-service availability and business continuity. Oversee user administration, access requests and technical problem resolution. Tooling engineering and lifecycle management Lead the maintenance and improvement of Nexus 3, GitLab, Bastion Services, AWX, HashiCorp Vault, Jenkins and Artifactory. Ensure patches, hotfixes, upgrades and lifecycle risks are identified and managed. Maintain AWS-hosted services, operating systems, containers, networking, automation and CI/CD capabilities. Architecture and assurance Work with technical architects and Technical Strategy & Assurance colleagues to translate architectural designs into supportable tooling solutions. Ensure tooling aligns with HMRC strategic architectural principles, standards and roadmaps. Delivery and knowledge management Deliver work through Agile practices. Ensure technical documentation and HMRC standards records are updated alongside delivery. Build resilience through structured knowledge sharing and transfer. Technical leadership and stakeholders Lead and support technical engineers delivering maintenance, changes and service improvements. Engage product managers, service owners, architects, suppliers and other stakeholders. Contribute technical evidence to technology roadmaps, workforce planning, budget decisions, projects and delivery priorities. Person specification As Senior Infrastructure Engineer within the Tooling & Automation team, you will provide senior technical leadership and work with infrastructure engineers to develop, maintain and support business-critical tooling services in accordance with HMRC standards and strategic direction. Protect live-service availability by identifying operational risks, coordinating technical resolution and ensuring services remain secure, resilient and supportable. Lead the administration, maintenance and continuous improvement of the team's tooling stack, including Nexus 3, GitLab, Bastion Services, AWX, HashiCorp Vault, Jenkins and Artifactory. Oversee day-to-day administration, user access requests and technical problem resolution for supported tooling services.
